Prices for the stay of Nov 14 to 16, 2026, as listed on October 10, 2026.

17 Muscat hotels, each priced on every booking site we recorded for it. Prices on this page are per night, all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees; the study's count below uses the before-tax prices of its CSV. The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price).

One snapshot on October 10, 2026 for Nov 14 to Nov 16, 2 adults, US market, USD. Prices change daily.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Muscat hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the October 10, 2026 snapshot, at 13 of the 17 Muscat hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Traveluro at 4, BusinessHotels.com at 2, the hotel's own site at 2, Agoda at 1, Booking.com at 1, Hoteles.com at 1, Super.com at 1 and Trip.com at 1. These are the Muscat rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 11 of the 17 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Traveluro at 3, Bluepillow.ca at 2, Bluepillow.com at 2, Agoda at 1, Bluepillow.ar at 1, Booking.com at 1, BusinessHotels.com at 1, Hoteles.com at 1 and 2 other sites at 2 between them (a tie counts for each site). At the other 6, no site was 5% or more below it. The two counts differ: at 2 of the hotels listed below, the all-in prices put the gap on the other side of the 5% line. Taxes and fees at Muscat hotels

At the 11 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 14% ($19 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 12% at Crowne Plaza Muscat by IHG to 15% at Mövenpick Hotel and Apartments Ghala Muscat. At 6 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
